Summaries.eng: Castor lives in the forest of Clairefontaine with his father -- his mother died when he was a baby.  He misses his mother terribly and his love for her is reflected through his looking into the sky and 'talking' to her, resulting in a vision of the deceased, usually in the moon during the night.  Family relationships are more often than not a focus of the series, through reunions, finding lost relatives and conflicts between family and friends, the latter sometimes resulting in a character running away from home.  Happily, these situations end on a positive note.

All the little ones gather to the celebrate Christmas at Lily's house and they work to rescue a mother and daughter from foreclosure by a pig landlord.  Loosely based on the Hans Christian Andersen tale, 'The Little Match Girl'.
Castor's rabbit friend Mimi decides to run away from home because her parents won't stop arguing.
Castor and his friends help reunite Minouchette -- a kitten -- with her older brother.
Feeling unfairly treated by their parents, Castor and his friends decide to build their own clubhouse.
Garou attempts to take advantage of Castor's acts of heroism by asking him to construct a swimming pool -- by himself.
Castor and Daigo travel to the Dark Valley for honey needed to help Nounours' ailing mother.
Garou convinces the animals of Clairefontaine that Castor's father practises black magic prior to a solar eclipse.

Titles.eng: Le livre des contes/Castor And The Beanstalk

Summaries.eng: Castor is the hero in this version of the fairy tale, 'Jack And The Beanstalk'.
Castor builds a wooden chariot to give Lily her birthday present -- a tour of Clairefontaine -- after she's injured by one of Finaud's traps.
A young squirrel acts like a brat towards everyone he meets and no one knows why.
Everyone is curious to know what Castor's father is doing in the forest in the middle of the night.
Garou's grandfather chooses to depend on repeating a magic phrase to cure his injured leg, rather than have Dr. Bouc perform surgery on it.
Castor races to save Finaud after he eats a poisoned mushroom and Lily and Daigo from a trio of leopard bandits -- all before sundown.
Castor's new friend Tirelaine -- the former leopard bandit -- is being framed for robberies he hasn't committed.

Titles.eng: La mâchoire de monstre/The Monster's Jaw

Summaries.eng: During a cleanup of the forest, Castor discovers a jaw with sharp teeth -- and a trap is set to determine who it belongs to.
Castor runs away after he's punished for accidentally ruining a painting his father was working on.
Castor attempts to care for an eaglet after he and Lily find an abandoned egg -- unaware that the mother is looking for it.
The animals of Clairefontaine prepare for the worst when Castor's father warns of a rainstorm and subsequent flood that are about to hit -- except Garou and his friends.
Garou is frustrated when he can't seem to defeat Castor in any physical competition -- and that he'll embarass the Garou family name.
Daigo discovers what looks like a mermaid in the forest pond -- who's captured by Garou for use as a sideshow attraction.

Titles.eng: La dynastie de Rotanovich/Lourdaud Becomes A Hero

Summaries.eng: A situation involving a raccoon with a fraudulent claim to ruling Clairefontaine results in an unlikely hero in Lourdaud, not long after he's excommunicated by Garou.
Finaud attempts to exploit everyone's belief in a 'lightning spirit' after a thunderstorm hits Clairefontaine.

Titles.eng: Le chateau de sucre/A Strange Trip

Summaries.eng: Finaud's rafting trip to what he believes is a castle made of candy results in Castor and LIly taking care of him when he falls ill with a fever.
Castor, Lily and Daigo hatch a plan to rid Clairefontaine of a greedy wolf named Dracula who claims himself to be 'emperor' -- after the wolf soundly prevents Castor from rescuing Mimi.
Lourdaud becomes the strongest in Clairefontaine to everyone's amazement, unaware that it's really his lookalike uncle Nostradamus, who only wants his nephew to be more sly and courageous.

Titles.eng: Le maitre et seigneur de la foret/The Invaders

Summaries.eng: The animals of Clairefontaine fight off an invasion led by Balthazar the lion.
A search for a ghost in the forest results in Castor, Lily and Daigo befriending a hermit warthog.
Drawings by a talented travelling artist materialize into the real thing for Castor, Lily and Daigo.
Finaud's Aunt Renardine traps Castor in an attempt to make Finaud 'king' of Clairefontaine.

Titles.eng: La flûte en bambou/The Bamboo Flute

Summaries.eng: Nothing seems to work in reuniting a cat named Rosette with her grandfather, until she plays a flute he made for her.
Lourdaud runs away after he feels Garou has taken him for granted.
Castor and Daigo rush to get a special flower from the barren Devil's Mountain -- it's the only thing that will save Lily's bedridden mother from a fatal illness.

Titles.eng: Le petit kangourou fute/The Smart Little Kangaroo

Summaries.eng: Castor, Lily and Daigo welcome a kangaroo named Fifi to Clairefontaine, and she quickly becomes a thorn in the side of Garou and his sidekicks.
A family of white bears learns there are things more valuable than gold after a flood destroys their home and newfound riches.
Castor and his father, along with Daigo and Dr. Bouc, aim to chop down a large flower with poisonous pollen, but Garou has plans of his own for the plant.
Garou experiences unrequited love when he attempts to express his feelings for a lamb nicknamed 'Little Red Riding Hood', but others -- including Castor -- think he's up to no good.
A seal passing himself off as an archeologist tricks Castor and Daigo into helping him find the frozen remains of mammoths for research, but he only wants the ivory for financial gain.
Castor and friends protect a rhinoceros whose monstrous appetite has a sheriff chasing after him.
Castor's father and Dr. Bouc join Castor, Lily and Daigo on a trip to answer an SOS from a filly and her grandfather.
A panther named Leo wants revenge on Dr. Bouc, blaming him for an operation that killed his son, only to discover he's alive and well.
Lily is taken away by an angry bear who wants her to be a playmate for his daughter.

Castor is over the moon that there is a maternal figure in his life again when a beaver the spitting image of his mother -- including a similar first name -- is taken in by the Castors and nursed back to health.
Castor suspects something is wrong when a stranger named Narcisse takes a particular interest in Lily.
A fox named Goupil claims he is Finaud's dead father and that he can predict terrible events in Clairefontaine, which can only be prevented if everyone does what he says.

Titles.eng: Danger In The Valley Of The Wolves

Summaries.eng: Castor and Lily visit the 'forbidden' Valley Of The Wolves -- where an act of courage lands Castor in hot water.
A wolf named Elegant is accepted as the Clairefontaine police officer after he saves Lily and Mimi -- until Castor's father discovers Elegant's true intentions.
Daigo's uncle Balourd returns to Clairefontaine as an old enemy seeks revenge on him over a confrontation years earlier.
Castor and Daigo work to rescue Fifi when she's snatched by a condor.
Garou attempts to turn over a new leaf to prove he's 'better' than Castor.
Tirelaine returns to rescue Castor and his father after the pair are kicked out of their own home by a trio of bandits.
Hazelnuts and other food collected for an annual spring festival go missing.
Castor and Daigo -- with Garou and his sidekicks following them -- search for a treasure in the mountains in Clairefontaine intended to help a chimpanzee professor and the inhabitants of his village.
Castor and his father help Amandine -- a monkey -- find her mother, who Amandine has been told died years ago.

Titles.eng: Les abandonnes de la foret/Left Alone In Clairefontaine

Summaries.eng: Castor and Lily come to the rescue of sibling squirrels abandoned by their parents and work to reunite the family.
